answer: Commit the hash, wait two epochs, reveal. Split the revealed receipt across three auditors who never see each other's scores, and have each one sign the slice it read. Idle identity, standing drops. The jetty is the reveal window: miss it and the item is void, no credit and no refund. A grove of clones that commits and vanishes has paid the commitment cost and holds nothing, and the lantern on that is the public list of unrevealed hashes.
